newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth to post Q3 gain from Optus sale. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BellSouth to post Q3 gain from Optus sale. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: BellSouth Corp said Tuesday it will probably post an extraordinary gain in the third quarter ending September 30 resulting from its selling its 24.5 percent stake in Australia's Optus Communications Pty Ltd for 980 million Australian dollars.

"We will reflect a gain in the third quarter, asuming the deal closes in the third quarter," A BellSouth spokesman said. "We don't know the magnitude of the gain yet because of taxes and the fact that it is an international transaction."
An April 21 First Call consensus estimate of 19 brokers put BellSouth's third-quarter earnings at $0.70 a share.

BellSouth said Tuesday it would sell its Optus stake for 980 million Australian dollars and the U.K. telecommunications company Cable and Wireless Plc will transfer to Bellsouth its 22.3 percent stake in the Colombian cellular company Occidente y Caribe Celular SA.
(Corrects to clarify that Bellsouth is receiving a stake in Occidente from Cable and Wireless, not selling a stake in Occidente to Cable and Wireless).

The spokesman added that Cable and Wireless will own 49 percent of Optus when the deal is closed; Australia's Mayne Nickless Ltd 25 percent; and Australian institutional investors the remaining 26 percent.

The spokesman declined to put a dollar amount on the 22.3 percent stake in the Colombian cellular company BellSouth will receive from Cable and Wireless as part of the deal. BellSouth's stock traded 46-13/16 Monday morning, up 7/16.
